items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: My sister played manly, my brother played guitar and I played cello.

ctx.x: Permit. Had you played in any band or anything? Did you play in any band or up there in Assumption Barrett before you came down?

We had three pieces, me and my brother and sister. See, because remember my sister played manly. My sister played manly, my brother played guitar and I played cello. Did your father and your mother play anything? No, my father and my uncle, my father and my brother, he was a little ham fat violin player. And we used to play those, you used to give those warm, see they used to give a dance, they call them balls. They get one big room man and give a dance, 25 cents to come in, see. 15 cents every bite, take it…
